# ros-mcp

ROS 2 CLI wrapper via MCP — introspect topics, services, nodes, and lifecycle.

## Tools
- ros_status / topic_list / topic_echo / topic_info — topic introspection
- service_list / service_call / service_type — service management
- node_list / node_info — node discovery
- param_get / param_set / param_list — parameter CRUD
- ros_launch / ros_stop / ros_log / list_jobs — process lifecycle

## Setup
```powershell
uv sync
uv run python -m ros_mcp
```

## Docs
- docs/ROS_MCP_ARCHITECTURE.md — CLI wrapper design, subprocess model
